title: Mid Cape Global Charter Academy
subtitle: Washington, D.C. · April 23–25, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing Mid Cape Global Charter Academy’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Arrival in Washington, D.C. & the Smithsonian Museums

  • Depart for Washington, D.C.
  • Arrive in Washington, D.C.! Meet your Tour Director at baggage claim
  • Lunch allocation
  • Group exploration of the Smithsonian Museums
  • Sit-down dinner
  • Return to hotel accommodations with overnight security (two nights)

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & Capitol Hill

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Landmark Leader–led walking tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch allocation
  • Public guided tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Group photo outside the Capitol Building
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Dinner allocation
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: Ford’s Theatre & African American History

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit Ford’s Theatre, the Petersen House, and the Aftermath Exhibits
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Lunch allocation
  • Depart for home
introHeading: Mid Cape Global Charter Academy, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From the rows of Arlington National Cemetery to the dome of the United States Capitol, this trip brings American history and civics to life at every turn. Students will take a guided tour of the Capitol, stand before the Charters of Freedom at the National Archives, explore the Library of Congress and the Smithsonian museums, walk the memorials of the National Mall, and trace the story of Ford’s Theatre. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
